sections.title: The letter tyé
paragraphs: The letter is named (tyé) /ceː/. It makes only one sound, heard in (tyúk) /ˈcuːk/, which means hen or chicken. This letter always represents this single sound in Hungarian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the broad middle part of your tongue flat against the hard roof of your mouth. Keep the tongue tip down behind your bottom front teeth. Block the air completely, then release it quickly with no voice. Put a hand on your throat to check that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /c/ in every word position. You hear it at the start of a word in (tyúk) /ˈcuːk/. You also hear it between vowels in the word (kutya) /ˈkucɒ/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say the sound like the start of tube or chin. Keep the tongue tip down behind your lower teeth. Flatten the middle of your tongue against the roof of your mouth instead. Release the breath sharply without making a hiss.
